Paper Name: Techno-economic and multicriteria analysis of grid-connected energy systems for hydrogen production: A case study from Bangladesh
NOTES: Optimal/baseline configuration is HRES3 (PV-Wind-Battery-Grid). No fuel cell in HRES3 so FC-related params null. No diesel generator so DG-related params null. Total annual community load is 12,630 kWh/day (daily value, not annual). Grid has tiered pricing: off-peak $0.0950/kWh, peak $0.1320/kWh; sellback: off-peak $0.05/kWh, peak $0.09/kWh. Nominal discount rate varied in sensitivity analysis (4%-12%) but base value not explicitly stated. COE not reported (LCOE reported instead). LPSP not reported (zero unmet load stated but no formal LPSP metric). eta_PV not explicitly reported. H2_LHV not explicitly reported. No emission factors given as per-unit values (only total annual emissions). No battery-specific efficiency or capacity parameters for the extraction template — battery strings reported as count, not kWh.
